record.edic_text:
07250 raba` {raw-bah'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 2108; v

AV - lie down 2, gender 1; 3

1) to lie stretched out, lie down
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) to lie down
            1a1a) for repose
            1a1b) for copulation (of woman with beast)
   1b) (Hiphil) to cause to lay down (of cattle breeding)
